title: voice.candidates
description: Host to client, answers voice.resolve. run: send command voice.run with choice 1 now. ask: ask the user to choose, then send the choice. reject: nothing to run; say the reason. Candidates are for display: voice.run names a resolution and a choice, never an operator.

resolution.description: What voice.run names. Single use; a rejected one can't be run.

reason.description: A sentence to speak: why it was rejected, or a note such as "levels capped at 2".

expires_in.description: Seconds after which voice.run gets not_found.

candidates.description: Best first; choice 1 is the one to run. Empty for reject.

choice.description: What voice.run sends: 1, 2 or 3, in order.

say.description: What to show and speak, with its values: "Array, 5 copies along Z".

operator.description: The Blender operator, for display only.

properties.description: Its operator properties, for display only.

set.description: Modifier properties set afterwards, for display only.

needs_target.description: voice.run must name the target that voice.resolve named.
